import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import warnings

warnings.simplefilter("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Check class distribution
class_counts = train["Cover_Type"].value_counts().sort_index()
print("Class distribution:", class_counts.to_dict())

feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X = train[feature_cols].values
y = train["Cover_Type"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values

# Stratified split but ensure all classes appear in val
# First, do a stratified split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# Check for missing classes in val and move one sample from train to val if needed
val_classes = set(y_val)
train_classes = set(y_train)
missing_in_val = train_classes - val_classes

for cls in missing_in_val:
    # Find an index in train with this class and move to val
    idx = np.where(y_train == cls)[0][0]
    X_val = np.vstack([X_val, X_train[idx : idx + 1]])
    y_val = np.concatenate([y_val, y_train[idx : idx + 1]])
    # Remove from train
    train_mask = np.ones(len(y_train), dtype=bool)
    train_mask[idx] = False
    X_train = X_train[train_mask]
    y_train = y_train[train_mask]

print(f"Training classes: {sorted(set(y_train))}")
print(f"Validation classes: {sorted(set(y_val))}")

model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    learning_rate=0.03,
    num_leaves=63,
    max_depth=8,
    min_child_samples=20,
    feature_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_freq=5,
    random_state=42,
    verbosity=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)])

val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
